> **Public issue — synthetic data only.** Everyone can read this report. Do not include real borrower or customer names, real financial figures, personal information, confidential documents, credentials, API keys, tokens, or leaked material. For a vulnerability or suspected data exposure, do not use this public template; follow the [security reporting policy](https://github.com/ShamikM88/open-cam-framework/blob/main/SECURITY.md). Never paste the secret or the confidential material itself.

## Problem

What is wrong? Describe the observed behaviour without real or confidential data.

## Concrete scenario

Give a minimal reproducible scenario using synthetic names, figures and files. Include the command or workflow and the observed result.

## Proposed fix

Describe a possible fix, if known. It is fine to leave this open if the right behaviour needs a decision.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] State the expected behaviour in testable terms.
- [ ] Use synthetic examples for all reproduction steps.
